title: COMMAND BLESSINGS THIS NEW DAY
text: Beloved, before we go into this place of prayer, I want you to do something for me. Share this prayer with someone right now. Send it to a friend, a family member, a colleague, somebody who needs to hear from heaven this morning. You don't know whose life you are about to change by simply pressing that share button. There is an anointing that travels. There is a grace that moves. And when you share what God is doing, you become a vessel of transmission. So, please share this before we go in, and let us now enter into the presence of the Lord together. Father, we worship you. We give you all the glory and all the honor this morning. You are the ancient of days, and yet you are present with us right now in this moment. We are grateful, Lord. We are deeply, deeply grateful. Now, beloved, I want you to settle in your spirit. I want you to calm every noise around you, every distraction. This is not just a devotional moment. This is a divine encounter. Every single morning that you wake up is not an accident. Every sunrise that greets your eyes is a deliberate act of [music] God. The mercy of the Lord is new every morning. The Bible says in Lamentations 3:22, 3:3, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." That means this morning, this specific morning carries a fresh batch of divine mercy that has never existed before. You have never experienced this exact mercy before today. God manufactured it fresh for you. So, wake up, believer. Wake up to what this morning carries. I need you to understand something foundational. You do not command blessings from a position of begging. You do not command blessings from a place of desperation. You command blessings from a place of authority, the authority that belongs to every son and daughter of the most high God. Romans 8:17 says that we are heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ. That is positional reality. That is not something you pray to become. That is something you already are. The question is whether you are living from that reality or whether you are living beneath it. And this morning I am here to tell you that you are going to rise to where you belong. Let me show you something from the book of Genesis. When God finished creating the heavens and the earth, when he spoke light into existence, when he separated the waters, when he formed man from the dust of the ground, the very first thing he did to Adam was not give him a task. The first thing God did was bless him. Genesis 1:28 says, "And God blessed them." Before the assignment came the blessing. Before the work came the empowerment. This tells you something critical about the nature of God. He does not send you into your assignment empty-handed. He blesses first and then he commissions. The blessing is the infrastructure upon which your assignment rides. Without the blessing, the assignment cannot be sustained. Now, what is a blessing? In the Hebrew understanding, the word is barak. It means to empower, to prosper, to cause to succeed, to speak well of someone in a way that determines their future. When God blesses you, he is not simply wishing you well. He's releasing divine energy into your life that causes you to flourish in every dimension. The blessing of God touches your health, it touches your mind, it touches your relationships, it touches your finances, it touches your destiny. It is comprehensive. It is all-encompassing. And this morning, we are not just asking for the blessing, we are commanding [music] it to manifest. There is a man in the scriptures whose life teaches us volumes about how to command blessings. His name is [music] Jacob. Now, I know the church sometimes shies away from Jacob because of his methods, but do not miss what the spirit of God is trying to show you in that narrative. In Genesis 32, Jacob is alone at the ford of Jabbok >> [music] >> and a man comes and wrestles with him. They struggled through the night and when the man who is a theophany, a pre-incarnate appearance of Christ, when this man touches Jacob's hip and dislocates it, Jacob does not run. He does not collapse. He holds on tighter and he makes one of the most powerful declarations in all of scripture. He says, "I will not let thee go except thou bless me." That is the posture of a man who understands that the blessing is not optional. That is the posture of a man who says, "I have come too far. I have endured too much. I have been [music] through too many wilderness seasons to walk away from this encounter empty-handed." Beloved, that needs to be your spirit this morning. Not a timid, passive, casual approach to God, but a holy desperation that says, "Lord, I am not leaving this place until something changes. I am not finishing this prayer until heaven responds. I am not walking into [music] this day without my blessing family in place." And watch what happened. Genesis 32 to 28 says God changed his name. "Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel, for as a prince has thou power with God and with men and has prevailed." Your name represents your identity and when God changes your name, he's changing your fundamental identity. He's saying, "You are no longer a supplanter. You are a prince. You are no longer defined by your past. You are defined by your prevailing And in verse 29, Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, "I have seen God face to face and my life is preserved." That word preserved means sustained, upheld, kept alive against all odds. I decree over you this morning that you are coming out of this prayer with a new name. There are things that have defined you, limitation, lack, delay, sickness, stagnation. I decree by the authority of scripture that those names are being stripped from you today. Your new name is blessed. Your new name is sustained. Your new name is favored of the Lord. Your new name is promoted. Your new name is healed. And this is not poetry, this is a prophetic decree backed by the authority of the [music] word of God. Now, let me show you another dimension. Deuteronomy 28 is one of the most extraordinary passages in all of scripture when it comes to understanding commanded blessings. Verse 1 and 2 say, "And it shall come to pass if thou shall hearken diligently onto the voice of the Lord thy God to observe and to do all his commandments which I commanded this day that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shall hearken onto the voice of the Lord thy God." Did you see that? All these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee. The word overtake speaks of acceleration, it speaks of something chasing you down. God said the blessings will run after you. You will not be crawling toward your blessing, [music] your blessing will be sprinting toward you. That is the covenant reality of the child of God. But I want to show you the condition. It says, "If thou shall hearken diligently." The word diligently in the Hebrew is shama shama. It is a doubling for intensity. It means to listen with extreme attention, to incline your ear with everything you have, to not just hear, but to hear and obey. Beloved, the blessing is not automatic, it is covenantal. It flows through the channel of obedience and consecration. This morning I want to ask you, are you in the place of hearing? Are you diligently pressing into the word? Because the same measure with which you diligently hear is the same measure with which the blessings will overtake you. Now, let me take you to the New Testament so you understand that this is not merely an old covenant reality. Galatians 3:13-14 tells us, "Christ hath redeemed us [music] from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us, for it is written, 'Cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree.'" "That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ, that we might receive the promise of the spirit through faith." Jesus became a curse so that the blessing of Abraham would come upon us. This is staggering. Everything that God promised Abraham, the comprehensive, generational, multi-dimensional blessing has been transferred to you through faith in Jesus Christ. >> [music] >> You are Abraham's seed. Galatians 3:29 says it plainly, "And if ye be Christ, then are ye Abraham's seed, and >> [music] >> heirs according to the promise." You are an heir. You are not a guest at the table, you own the table. You did not earn it, you inherited it. An inheritance becomes active when you know what belongs to you. This is the problem with many believers. We do not know what belongs to us. We walk through life like spiritual orphans when we are actually covenant children of the Most High. Paul prayed in Ephesians 1:17-18 that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him. The eyes of your understanding being enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling. And what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints. Paul was not praying for people to get saved, he was writing to the saints at Ephesus. He was praying that believers would know their inheritance because you cannot possess what you do not know you have. Revelation precedes possession. Insight precedes acquisition. When your eyes of understanding are opened, you begin to reach for and receive what has always been yours. I want to speak to someone this morning who has been waiting for a long time. >> [music] >> You have been praying, you have been believing, you have been standing on the word, and it feels like heaven is brass. It feels like your prayers are bouncing off the ceiling. I want you to know God has not forgotten you. Isaiah 49:15 says, "Can a woman forget her sucking child that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee." God says even a mother with all the natural instincts of maternal love, even a mother might forget, but I will not forget you. And then in verse 16, he says, "Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands." Your name is literally engraved on the hands of God. Every time God moves his hands, and his hands are always moving, always working, he sees your name, he sees your situation, he has not looked away from your case. Now, let us begin to pray. I want you to stand on your feet if you can. I want you to lift your hands toward heaven. Lift them as a signal of surrender and as a posture of receiving. We are entering into the courts of heaven this morning with boldness. Hebrews 4:16 says, "Let us therefore come boldly onto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." Boldly, not sheepishly, not apologetically, boldly because he's your father and you are his [music] child and the door is always open to you. Father, in the name of Jesus, we approach your throne right now. We come not by our own righteousness, not by our own merit, not by the credentials of our performance, we come by the blood of the lamb. Revelation 12:11 says, "We overcome by the blood of the lamb and by the word of our testimony." So, we plead the blood of Jesus over this prayer. We plead the blood of Jesus over everyone who is praying with us this morning. Father, by that blood, every voice of the enemy that would resist our prayers is silenced right now. Every principality and power that would intercept [music] our petitions before they reach the throne is arrested by the blood of Jesus Christ. Father, we thank you for this new day. We thank you that your mercies have been freshly released this morning. We receive those mercies. We receive the new grace. We receive the new anointing that comes with this day. Lord, we declare that this is not just another ordinary day. This is a day of divine turn around. This is a day of commanded blessing. This is a day that you have made and we will rejoice and be glad in it. Now Father, we come to you on behalf of every person praying with us. Lord, you know them by name. You know their situation. You know the battles they have [music] been fighting in secret. You know the tears they have cried in the night season. Father, this morning I am asking you to command the blessing of the Lord upon their lives. Psalm 133:2-3 says that where there is unity, where there is harmony, where brothers dwell together in love, you command [music] the blessing, even life forevermore. Lord, we are unified in faith this [music] morning. We are one in the spirit. And we're calling on you to command the blessing. Lord, command the blessing upon their health. Father, in the name of Jesus, I decree that every sickness is evicted from the bodies of the people praying right now. I decree that healing is released through this prayer. I pray against every malignant growth, every inflammation, every disorder, every dysfunction. I speak to bodies right now in the name of Jesus. Be healed. Be restored. Be made whole. The Bible says in Isaiah 53:2-5, with his stripes we are healed. That is past tense. That means healing is already purchased. It has already been paid for. So Father, we are not asking you to do something new. We are appropriating what Jesus already did. Healing belongs to us. We receive it now by faith in the name of Jesus. I speak specifically to someone praying with us this morning [music] who has been dealing with a matter in your head. Headaches, mental pressure, confusion, or something affecting your mind and your thinking. I decree in the name of Jesus that the spirit of infirmity is broken. 2 Timothy 1:7 says, "God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." A sound mind belongs to you. I command soundness into your mind right now. I command clarity. I command peace. I command healing into every neural pathway in the name of Jesus. Father, command the blessing upon their finances. Lord, I come against every spirit of poverty and lack. I decree the blessing of Deuteronomy 28:8, "The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses [music] and in all that thou settest thine hand onto and he shall bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee." Father, command the blessing on their storehouses. Every account that has been depleted, Lord, let the rain of heaven begin to refill it. I command debts to break in the name of Jesus. I command unexpected income to find the people praying with us. I command divine connections that release financial breakthrough to locate them. Proverbs 10:22 says, "The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich and he addeth no sorrow with it." Lord, release that kind of blessing, the rich making blessing, the sorrow free blessing, the blessing that comes from above and not from below. I prophesy over someone listening to this right now. There is an amount that is coming to you, an amount that will surprise you. God has been arranging it. There are hands that are going to release what has been held. There are doors that have been locked that the Lord is going to open with a key that no man gave him and no man can shut. Isaiah 22:22 says, "And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder. So, he shall open and none shall shut and he shall shut and none shall open. That key is active over your situation right now. What man has shut, God is opening. What has been delayed is being released. What has been frozen is thawing right now in the name of Jesus. Father, we command the blessing upon their relationships. Lord, I pray over marriages this morning. For every marriage that is under pressure, under attack, fighting, struggling, Father, release the spirit of reconciliation. Restore the communication. Restore the intimacy. Restore the vision. Let the enemy not have dominion over covenant relationships. I decree that love is being rekindled. [music] I decree that what the enemy has broken, God is repairing. What the enemy has hardened, God is softening. The spirit of the Lord is moving over homes and families this morning. For those who are believing for a godly partner, I declare that your season of waiting is shifting. Lord, according to Proverbs 18:22, "Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing and obtaineth favor of the Lord." Father, release divine alignment. Let the right person be moved toward them. Let every wrong connection be cut off by your wisdom and grace. Let every counterfeit be exposed and removed. And let the genuine covenant aligned God-sent partner begin to come into position in the name of Jesus. For families, Lord, I pray over prodigal children. I pray over wayward sons and daughters. Luke 15:20 says, "When the prodigal son came to himself and turned toward [music] home, the father saw him afar off and ran." Father, run toward the prodigal sons and daughters of the people praying with us. Let conviction grip them. Let your goodness lead them to repentance. Romans 2:2-4 says, "It is the goodness of God [music] that leads to repentance." Lord, pour out your goodness on every prodigal in our families. Bring them home. Bring them back. Restore the years that the locust has eaten in those relationships. Father, command a blessing upon their destinies and their callings. Lord, I pray over dreams and visions that have gone dormant. I pray over gifts and talents that have been buried under discouragement and delay. I decree that this morning is a resurrection morning for dreams. Joseph was in the pit, but the pit could not hold him. He was in Potiphar's house, but betrayal could not stop him. He was in prison, but the prison could not contain the anointing on his life. And Genesis 41:14 says, "When it was time, Pharaoh sent and called for Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. Hastily." That word tells you that when God decides to promote you, the speed of the promotion will shock you. What took years to build up will come undone in a moment. What blocked you for a decade can be removed in a day when God commands the blessing. I prophesy over someone this morning, your time of being in the dungeon is over. Your time of being overlooked, being passed over, being underestimated, that season is concluding. God is about to bring you before a Pharaoh. He's about to put you in a room you did not qualify for by human standards. He's about to give you a platform that is too large for your CV. Because God does not [music] promote based on your qualifications, he promotes based on his purpose. And his purpose for you is higher than what your circumstances have suggested. Now, let us go deeper into prayer. I want you to pray with me militantly. The kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force. Matthew 11:12. We are not passive recipients. We are aggressive faith-filled believers who enforce the victory of Calvary. So, open your mouth right now and begin to say, "Father, I thank you that I am blessed coming in [music] and blessed going out. I am blessed in the city and blessed in the field. I am blessed in my body and blessed in my basket. Every blessing enumerated in Deuteronomy 28 belongs to me because [music] Christ has redeemed me from the curse. I am Abraham's seed and an heir according to the promise. I operate under an open heaven today. The heavens over my life are not brass, they are open. The windows of heaven are open over my finances, over my health, over my family, over my destiny. Father, I take authority over every spirit of delay and frustration. I command every clock of stagnation in my life to be destroyed in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> I will not experience delay in this season. I will not experience frustration in this season. I command divine acceleration. I command divine momentum. What should have taken 10 years, Lord, do it in one. What should have taken five years, compress it in the power of your spirit. Lord, you are the God who restores the years. Joel 2:25 says, "I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm." Father, I receive that restoration of years this morning. I receive what the enemy has stolen. I receive double for every shame. Isaiah 61:2-7 says, "For your shame you shall have double." I receive it now in the name of Jesus. Beloved, let me speak to you again for a moment. Let me give you something to carry through this day. Psalm 34:2-10 says, "The young lions do lack and suffer hunger, but they that seek the Lord shall not want any [music] good thing. The lion is a symbol of natural strength, natural ability, natural prowess. And the psalmist says, "Even the strong will lack, but the one who seeks the Lord will not want any good thing." This is extraordinary. The promise is not attached to your education level. It is not attached to your connections in the natural. It is not attached to your economic background. The promise is attached to seeking the Lord. Seeking is an activity. It is a discipline. It is a deliberate [music] posture of the heart. And those who build their lives around seeking the Lord become recipients of comprehensive provision. This is why I always say to people, "Your greatest investment this morning is not in the stock market, as important as that may be." Your greatest investment is in this time of prayer, in [music] this time of word meditation, in this time of seeking the face of God. Because Psalm 16:11 says, "In thy presence is fullness of joy. At thy right hand there are pleasures forevermore." Everything you need, everything you are looking for, every breakthrough you have been pursuing, it is found in His presence. And when you are a man or woman who knows how to get into that presence, you become untouchable by the forces of lack and limitation. David said in Psalm 23, "The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want." That is a declaration. That is a commanded reality. I shall not want. Not, "I hope I won't [music] want." Not, "I am praying I won't want." I shall not want. That is the language of covenant confidence. That is the language of a man who knows his shepherd. David was a king, but he reduced himself to a sheep because he understood that under the care of the right shepherd, the sheep wants for nothing. And Jesus said in John 10:11, "I am the good shepherd." He is your shepherd this morning. Under His care, lack has no place. Under His care, disease has no dominion. Under his care, the future is secure. Now, I want to pray something very specific. I want to pray about open doors. Because, beloved, this is not just about blessing in the abstract. God moves through specific doors of opportunity. He moves through divine connections. He moves through strategic moments. And there are people praying right now who are at the threshold of a door that is about to open. You have been standing before it. You have been knocking on it. And God is about to answer in a [music] way that is beyond what you imagined. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray over every door of opportunity for the people praying with us right now. Lord, open doors that no man can shut. Open doors of favor. Open doors of business opportunity. Open doors of education and scholarship. Open doors of promotion and elevation. Open doors of ministry and assignment. Father, let doors open before them, and let them walk through with confidence and with grace. I pray against [music] every door that the enemy has locked. Every opportunity that has been sabotaged by [music] demonic interference, I decree in the name of Jesus that the interference is broken. I decree that the hands that were working against them are paralyzed in the name of Jesus. Colossians 2:15 says Jesus spoiled principalities and powers. He made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. The victory has already been won. So, right now, every principality that is guarding a closed door over your life, I address you with the authority of the name of Jesus. Your assignment is terminated. The door is opening. The access is granted, and the people of God are walking through in Jesus' name. I want to spend some moments now in prophetic declaration. Say these things after me in your heart, or out loud confess them over your life, over your household, over your day. Today is my day of commanded blessing. I do not enter this day as a victim. I enter this day as a victor. The blood of Jesus speaks over my life this morning. The blessing of Abraham rests upon me. Every assignment of the enemy against my peace, my health, my provision, and my destiny is broken and rendered ineffective in the name of Jesus. I declare that I have the mind of Christ today. I will think clearly. I will make wise decisions. I will not miss divine moments. My ears are open to hear the voice of the spirit. My heart is open to receive instruction and guidance. I am led by the spirit of God. Romans 8:14 says, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God." I am a son. I am a daughter. I move by divine leading today. I declare that divine favor surrounds me as a shield. Psalm 5:12 says, "For thou, Lord, will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him [music] as with a shield." Favor is my shield today. When I walk into rooms, favor walks ahead of me. When I speak, people hear me and respond with supernatural goodwill. When I apply, I am accepted. When I seek, I find. When I knock, it is open to me. This is my reality today because of who my father is. Let me take you to one more passage before we conclude. Numbers 6:24-26 contains what is known as the Aaronic blessing, [music] one of the oldest recorded blessings in all of scripture. God himself dictated this to Moses >> [music] >> and told the priest to speak it over the children of Israel. And God said in verse 27, "And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and [music] I will bless them." This is phenomenal. When the blessing is spoken over you, the name of God is placed upon you. You carry the name and there is no force in the universe that can overcome someone who carries the name of Yahweh. The Lord bless thee and keep thee. That word keep means to guard, to watch over with the vigilance of a sentinel. God is your personal security detail this morning. The Lord make his face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee. The shining face of God is the light of divine approval. When God's face shines on you, every dark plot against you is exposed and destroyed. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace, the peace of God. Philippians 4:7 calls it the peace of God, which passeth all understanding. It is a peace that does not require good circumstances to function. It is a supernatural calm in the middle of every storm. And it shall keep guard, protect, garrisoning your heart and your mind through Christ Jesus. Father, I speak this ancient blessing over every person in this prayer right now. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May the Lord make his face shine upon [music] you and be gracious to you. May the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Peace in your spirit, peace in your mind, [music] peace in your home, peace in your finances, peace in your body, peace in every dimension of your existence in the name of Jesus. Now, beloved, let us close in warfare prayer. Because blessing without protection is incomplete. The blessing of God attracts attention and we must cover it with aggressive intercession. Father, I pray a wall of fire around every person who has prayed with us today. Zechariah 2:5 says, "For I sayeth the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about [music] and will be the glory in the midst of her." Lord, be their wall of fire. Be the glory in their midst. Let no weapon of the enemy penetrate that wall. Isaiah 54:17, I declare it over them right now. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper. And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. No weapon. I did not say no attack. I said no weapon shall prosper. The enemy may bring an attack, but every attack must fail. Every plot must unravel. Every conspi- -racy must be exposed. Every witchcraft prayer spoken against them [music] must return to sender in the name of Jesus. I break every generational curse operating over bloodlines this morning. Every pattern of sickness that runs in families broken in the name of Jesus. Every pattern [music] of poverty, of premature death, of failure at the edge of breakthrough broken in the name of Jesus. Galatians 3:13 says Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law. That redemption is comprehensive and complete. So, by the authority of that redemption, I sever every ancestral chain. I cut every umbilical cord connecting people to generational curses. You are free. You are free. The Son has set you free. And John 8:36 says, "If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed." Indeed, [music] completely, entirely, without exception. Free indeed. I command the hosts of [music] heaven to be released on behalf of the people praying with us. Psalm 91:11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways." Lord, release those angels. Let them go ahead of the people praying with us today. Let them clear pathways. Let them arrange encounters. Let them shut the mouths of those who would speak against God's people. Just as the angels shut the mouths of the lions in Daniel's den. Lord, let your angels be active, be engaged, be working on behalf of everyone in this prayer right now. Father, I come against every spirit of discouragement and hopelessness. Lord, there are people praying with us who have almost given up, almost. They are holding on by a thread. Father, this morning I ask you to be their strength. Isaiah 40:29 says he giveth power to the faint and to them that have no might, he increaseth strength. Lord, increase their strength right now. Let this prayer be the turning point. Let this become the Elijah moment where the angel touches them and says, "Arise and eat because the journey is too great for thee." 1 Kings 19:7. Lord, give them food for the journey. Give them water in the wilderness. Give them strength that outlast their circumstances. I declare over someone this morning, you are [music] not going to quit. You are not going to give up. You are not going to walk away from what God has called you to. The grace that started this thing in you is sufficient to finish it. Philippians 1:6 says, "Being confident of this very thing, that he which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ." God is not a quitter. And because his spirit lives in you, you carry the nature of a finisher. You will finish, you will complete, [music] you will see the end of this battle as a victor and not as a casualty. This is your word this morning. This is your prophetic word. Take it and run with it. Father, as we round up this prayer, we want to commit this day entirely into your hands. Proverbs 3:5-6 says, "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways, acknowledge him and he shall direct thy paths." Lord, we are trusting you today with every decision, every movement, >> [music] >> every word we will speak, every transaction we will make, every relationship we will interact with. We acknowledge you in all our ways and we are counting on you to direct our paths. Let every divine appointment scheduled for today be kept. Let us not miss the person you want us to meet, the word you want us to hear, the door you want us to walk through. Give us ears to hear the Holy Spirit throughout this day. Give us eyes to see the opportunities that you are releasing. Give us wisdom to respond correctly in every situation. Father, I pray that the blessing that has been commanded this morning will not be temporary. Let it be perpetual. Let it continue to flow. Let it be a river and not a puddle. Let it be a spring that does not dry up. John 4:14, Jesus said, "But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst. But the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life." Lord, let your blessing be that kind of well springing up continuously, never [music] exhausted, always fresh, always overflowing. I declare that goodness and mercy shall follow the people who have prayed with us today. Not walk behind them at a distance, follow them. Actively pursue them. Psalm 23:6, "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life." All the days, not some days, not the good days. All the days including the difficult days, including the days that started wrong, including the days when the enemy tried [music] to steal their joy. On every one of those days, goodness and mercy are following them. And they shall dwell in the house of the Lord forever. Beloved, as I release you into this day, I want you to carry this awareness. [music] You are not ordinary, you are not an accident of biology, you are not a product of your circumstances. You are a masterpiece of God Almighty. Ephesians 2:10 says, "For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God had before ordained that we should walk in them." The word workmanship in the Greek is poiema, from which we get the word poem. You are God's poem. You are his creative expression, and God does not write mediocre poetry. He writes masterpieces. You are a masterpiece, and today that masterpiece is going to be on display for the glory of God. Go into this day with your head up. Go with your shoulders back. Go with the confidence of someone who has spent time in the presence of the most high. Go knowing that the blessing has been commanded. Go knowing that heaven is backing [music] you up.
